notes:
### Added
- **Japanese artwork completed.** The three PCG7-9 sets (Holon Phantom, Miracle
  Crystal, Offense and Defense of the Furthest Ends) turned out to have TCG
  Collector pages after all — they were simply never mapped — and the secret
  rares plus 30th-anniversary basic energies (SV8 107-138, SV10 99-132, S12a
  255-258, M6a/MC/MF energies) were reachable through each set page's
  `anyCardVariant` view. 286 images added: Japanese art is now 13,004 of 13,006
  cards (99.98%), up from 12,718.
- **Set icons for every Japanese set.** The icon map covered 23 of 118 sets;
  the remaining 95 now come from TCG Collector set logos, so no Japanese series
  or set row renders blank.
- **English names for PCG7-9** (195 cards) — the last Japanese sets that read in
  Japanese. English-name coverage is now 13,004 of 13,006.
- `scripts/fill-missing-jp-artwork.mjs` — gap-only artwork fill (TCG Collector
  set pages first, Limitless TCG as the fallback source), `--dry` to report.
- `scripts/lib/jpSetsMap.mjs` — the shared TCG Collector set map used by the
  artwork and icon scrapers (one source of truth, PCG7-9 included).
- `scripts/publish-artwork.mjs` — publishes scraped artwork/icons to
  `pocketvault-data` (content-compared, token-masked, `--dry` / `--no-push`).
- Themes: **Parchment** and **Sakura** (light), **Graphite**, **Gilded** and
  **Black** (OLED) alongside the existing six; the browser/PWA `theme-color` now
  follows the chosen theme instead of the two system defaults.
- A first-load splash: brand mark, animated progress bar and a card count while
  the bundled catalogue seeds, replacing the plain "Preparing card database…".
- Series headers on the Sets page now show the release-year range
  (e.g. `Neo 2000–2002`, `Platinum 2009`).
- Scan results are badged **AI** when a capture was identified by the vision
  model; the manual "AI identify" button now records that too.

### Changed
- **English and Japanese catalogues no longer mix on the Sets page.** The
  Japanese series key `"XY"` is byte-identical to the English one, so the two
  Japanese concept packs (CP1/CP2) were folded into the English XY generation.
  Groups are now language-scoped, the English catalogue always precedes the
  Japanese one, and the Japanese block is ordered oldest-first.
- Returning to a list restores your scroll position reliably. The restore was a
  one-shot `scrollTo` that ran while the view was still on its loading state, so
  it was clamped to the top and never retried.
- Settings: the section and toggle now both read "AI Condition Check" (was
  "AI Condition" / "AI Grading"), and there is a gap between a toggle row and
  its description.
- `DATA_VERSION` bumped, so installs reseed with the new artwork and names.

### Fixed
- `npm run scan-index` failed on Windows with `spawnSync npx.cmd EINVAL` (Node
  no longer spawns `.cmd` shims directly, and the local index build shells out
  to `npx tsx`). It now runs the repo's own `tsx` CLI through `node`, with the
  `npx` path kept as a fallback; `npm.cmd` calls also spawn through a shell.

### Notes
- Scan-index rebuild required (card data changed) and done locally: a partial
  rebuild of the sets whose artwork changed, merged into the published index.
- Known gaps: 158 TCG Pocket (digital-only) cards and 38 physical cards
  (`exu` Unown 27, `cel25cc` 4, `30th-c` 4, `mfb` 3) still have no artwork, plus
  the two bogus TCGdex rows (`ja-neo2 057`, `ja-neo4 229`) that are not real
  cards. Six English sets (`sve`, `mee`, McDonald's 2014/2015/2017/2018) point at
  image URLs that 404, so those 80 cards stay unindexable until re-sourced.
